summary: Verified the new 'Member Invites' feature end-to-end. Backend: full pytest regression 117 passed / 1 skipped (new test_invites.py included: owner-only access, dedupe/skip reasons, unsubscribe token validation). Frontend (desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844): admin login works; /admin/invites loaded with testids admin-invites-page + invite-composer; sidebar shows admin-nav-invites for owner (desktop), mobile hamburger reveals admin-mnav-invites. Composer parses the 3 line formats correctly (invite-count shows '4 people · 0/300' for the test paste with Name,email + Name<email> + email + bad), note textarea respects 300-char limit, send btn disabled when empty and enabled otherwise. Sending 'Alice,test_iter7a@example.com | Bob<test_iter7b@example.com> | test_iter7c@example.com | notanemail' + note 'Hello from the team' returned skipped=1 ('notanemail isn't a valid email') and queued 3 rows which appeared as invite-status-<id>=Sending, then auto-refreshed to 'Not sent' within ~6s (expected per request — Resend sandbox rate-limits @example.com addresses; this is the expected 'Not sent' state, not a bug). All 5 filter pills visible (all/sent/joined/failed/unsubscribed), CSV present, invite-retry-btn surfaced once rows reached Not-sent state. Activity page at /admin/activity shows 'Sent member invites' row with details '1 skipped · Note: Hello from the team' (invites.sent activity entry works). Unsubscribe public page tested at 390px: valid token from /tmp/unsub_url shows unsubscribe-page + confirm btn; clicking posts to /api/invites/unsubscribe and reveals unsubscribe-done 'We won't send invites to test_unsub@example.com again'. Missing token shows unsubscribe-missing with button disabled. Garbage token shows unsubscribe-error after submit. Owner-only backend contract verified (member 403, anon 401) via test_invites.py. No ObjectId leakage; emails lowercased + deduped; failed invites updated in-place instead of duplicated (find_one_and_update on status=failed).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/invites.py (147 lines) is clean, single-purpose. EMAIL_RX allows TLDs <2 ascii-letters only — intentional to reject 'nope' and acceptable.

deliver() processes queued invites serially per request — good: one slow send doesn't hold the API. Failure path persists first 200 chars of the provider error into invite.error which is surfaced as the 'problem text' pill subtext — correct UX.

retry_failed re-sends anything status=failed except error=='Unsubscribed' — note the check is case-sensitive string match on 'Unsubscribed'. Currently set only by deliver()'s own branch, so safe. If any future code path writes a lowercase 'unsubscribed' error it would be retried unexpectedly; consider skipping by email in email_optouts instead of by error text.

Unsubscribe tokens are JWT with 10-year expiry — long but reasonable for email receipts. Token-type check prevents using access/refresh tokens, verified by test_invites.test_unsubscribe_blocks_future_invites.
log_activity for invites.sent only fires when queued>0; a paste that is 100% skipped produces no activity row — correct (nothing was actually sent).
Composer HTML/UI correctly truncates note at 300 chars via maxLength + the live counter in invite-count.

success_rate.backend: 100% (117 passed, 1 intentional skip; 3/3 new invite tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on admin invites composer + table + filters + retry, activity log integration, mobile admin menu, and public unsubscribe (valid/missing/bad token)

test_credentials: Used seed admin + member unchanged. Created only test_iter7a/b/c@example.com invite rows and test_unsub@example.com opt-out. Did not touch seed passwords or roles.
seed_data_creation: Invites created during manual UI test (test_iter7a/b/c@example.com) remain in db.invites as status=failed per sandbox rate-limit; they are deliberately testid'd rows with TEST_-equivalent @example.com addresses and harmless. test_unsub@example.com is in email_optouts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Invite UI testids: admin-nav-invites (desktop), admin-mnav-invites (mobile, visible only after opening hamburger), admin-invites-page, invite-composer, invite-list-input, invite-count, invite-note-input, invite-send-btn, invite-skipped, invite-retry-btn, invites-row-<id>, invite-status-<id>, invites-filter-{all,sent,joined,failed,unsubscribed}. DataTable id='invites' with CSV export. Public unsubscribe page: unsubscribe-page/unsubscribe-confirm-btn/unsubscribe-done/unsubscribe-error/unsubscribe-missing. Backend routes: POST/GET /api/admin/invites (owner-only), POST /api/admin/invites/retry (owner-only), POST /api/invites/unsubscribe (public, body.token JWT). Expected: sends to @example.com likely show 'Not sent' due to Resend sandbox rate-limit — treat as expected, not a bug. Use /tmp/unsub_url for a valid test_unsub@example.com token, or `cd /app/backend && python3 -c "from core import make_token; from datetime import timedelta; print(make_token('x@example.com','unsubscribe',timedelta(days=1)))"`.
rca of the issue: No defects found. Feature meets all spec items: owner-only ACL, ready-made email + optional 300-char note, parse 3 formats, dedupe/skip reasons, unsubscribe link in email, retry for failed, activity log entry, public unsubscribe page with token validation, mobile-friendly.
